## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmers: weak sector breadth (4/11) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology. Style: Growth/Momentum (cautious given mixed breadth).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +5.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.53% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong on names: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing resilience: SCHW (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials weak: PPG (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION, SHW (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION. Healthcare soft: ABBV (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples lag: PEP (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: +1.84% | 1M: -4.19%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY, CSCO (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); style: Growth/Momentum concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION, LOW (1W: -6.98% | 1M: -2.64%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION, PANW (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +25.10%) CORRECTION, DE (1W: -5.54% | 1M: +1.91%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated across several high-volatility names (trend exhaustion noted).

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: multiple large caps show 1W vs 1M mismatches (MA, V, INTC, PANW) — major divergence present, watch for trend break rather than broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but headline-driven: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND. Sector is leading on concentrated names while many other techs show exhaustion; sector performance:+2.14% (24 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Constructive internals: SCHW (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -3.63% | 1M: +7.36%) CORRECTION. Financials are a relative bright spot supporting mixed market posture.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Rotational and selective: ABBV (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -2.09% | 1M: +3.84%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -2.30% | 1M: +8.43%) CORRECTION. Defensive names showing short-term pullbacks amid sector underperformance.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to leading Tech names and resilient Financials while reducing exposure to names with trend exhaustion in Materials and large-cap techs that are correcting. Given major divergence and narrow leadership, treat new positions tactically and monitor sentiment-driven reversals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND — monitor supply/AI headlines.  
BEARISH: INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION — headline-sensitive; PEP (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND — consumer staples soft.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (leading on top names) — concentration risk; Energy (momentum among refiners/oil majors) recovering.  
BEARISH: Materials and Healthcare — several names in CORRECTION or showing trend exhaustion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
META short-term support to watch on pullback; NVDA resistance test around recent highs (monitor for follow-through). INTC downside momentum to watch for trend confirmation; SCHW breakout continuation would confirm Financials strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
DE (+60): Deere (DE) — Right-to-repair deal headline; DE (1W: -5.54% | 1M: +1.91%) CORRECTION — news supportive but price soft, watch for stabilization.  
INTC (+50): Intel (INTC) — Server chip price hike headline; INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION — bullish news but price falling (divergence).  
EQIX (+50) / ACN (+50) noted in headlines but not in the top lists above; monitor for follow-through if entering list.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-60): Meta faces probe headline; META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND — clear divergence: negative headlines but strong price (distribution risk).  
NVDA (-45): Nvidia rack delay headline; NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND — negative press but price strength (watch for mean reversion).  
CRM (-50): Salesforce headline negative; CRM not in top/bottom list above but monitor if price confirms news-driven weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum style. META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Tech leadership with major sentiment-price divergences (META, NVDA headlines negative despite price strength) and breadth only 4/11 sectors positive.
